meal_templates.name: South Indian
meal_templates.description: Traditional South Indian meal. Main curry with rice and/or roti, a complementary side dish, eggs, and salad.

required_components.description: Primary curry (sambar, avial, molagootal, moru kootan, etc.)
Rice as the primary carb, with roti available for household members who prefer it.
5 eggs daily — style rotated (boiled/omelette/scrambled/fried)
Sliced carrots + cucumbers

optional_components.description: Poriyal, mezhukkuvaratty, olan, etc. — complementary dry/semi-dry side
Thayir pachadi, puli pachadi, thogayal, papadam, pickle

roti_rules.note: On South Indian days, rice stays primary and no extra rotis are needed.

meal_templates.name: North Indian
meal_templates.description: North Indian meal — roti-forward. Curry with roti for the household, optional curd rice side, eggs, and salad.

required_components.description: Primary curry (palak paneer, mutter paneer, veg kolhapuri, egg curry, etc.)
Roti/chapati for the household. Add 5 extra rotis on roti-forward days for the higher-appetite adult.
5 eggs daily — style rotated. May be part of main dish (egg curry) in which case separate eggs may not be needed.
Sliced carrots + cucumbers

optional_components.description: Raita, papad, pickle, or a simple stir-fry
Optional curd rice side when the household wants a lighter rice accompaniment

roti_rules.note: On North Indian days, everyone eats roti. Make 5 extra rotis for the higher-appetite adult.

meal_templates.name: Indo-Chinese
meal_templates.description: Indo-Chinese meal — a main fried rice/noodle dish with a protein-rich side, eggs (if not in main), and salad.

required_components.description: Fried rice, noodles, or similar Indo-Chinese main
Tofu stir-fry, gobi manchurian, paneer stir-fry, or similar protein-rich side
Sliced carrots + cucumbers

optional_components.description: If the main doesn't include eggs (e.g., veg fried rice), add separate eggs. If main is egg fried rice, eggs may already be covered.

carb_rules.note: Some household members may eat the rice/noodle dish directly or want roti on the side.

meal_templates.name: Bengali
meal_templates.description: Bengali meal — rich curries with rice and/or roti, eggs, and salad.

required_components.description: Bengali main dish (dhokar dalna, cholar dal, etc.)
Rice as the primary carb for Bengali meals, with roti available for roti-first members.
5 eggs daily — style rotated
Sliced carrots + cucumbers

optional_components.description: Bhaja (fried vegetable), bori, or a light accompaniment

meal_templates.name: Comfort / One-Pot
meal_templates.description: Comfort meals — one-pot dishes like khichdi, egg curry with rice. Simple and wholesome.

required_components.description: One-pot or self-contained dish (dal khichdi, egg curry + rice, etc.)
If not part of main, 5 eggs daily — rotated style
Sliced carrots + cucumbers

optional_components.description: Papad, pickle, curd, or a simple stir-fry

carb_rules.note: If the main is rice-based, some household members may still want roti on the side.

meal_templates.name: International (Future)
meal_templates.description: International cuisines — miso ramen, Mexican bowls, Thai curries, etc. Post-MVP expansion.

required_components.description: International main dish
Contextual — may be part of dish or separate
Contextual — may be part of dish or standard salad
